# ARLing Asistent

> AI shopping assistant widget for e-shops: builds itself from a product feed (Heureka/Zboží.cz XML as exported by Shoptet or Upgates, Google Shopping XML, Shopify, WooCommerce, or a generic XML feed) in minutes, runs on Cloudflare Workers, and stores no conversation content, only daily aggregate counters.

Store owners embed a single `<script>` tag. The widget shows a chat panel, answers only from the shop's own product feed and contact details, always in the visitor's language (Slovak, Czech, English, or German), and links to up to 3 real products per answer. If nothing in the feed answers the question, it says so and points to the shop's contact email instead of guessing.

## How it works

1. The shop owner submits their feed URL and email at https://arling.sk/asistent/#playground.
2. A Cloudflare Worker downloads the feed, strips HTML, chunks each product's title and description, embeds it with Workers AI (`@cf/baai/bge-m3`), and stores the vectors in Cloudflare Vectorize, namespaced per tenant. The feed refreshes automatically once a day.
3. The shop adds `widget/widget.js` as a `<script>` tag with a `data-tenant` attribute. Each customer question is embedded and matched against the shop's own product vectors (top 8), and a grounded prompt (products and shop facts wrapped as untrusted data, never as instructions) is sent to a Workers AI chat model, which must reply with only a short answer plus up to 3 real, retrieved product links.

## Privacy

No conversation content is ever stored, by any component. The only stored state is a tenant record (domain, feed URL, contact email, plan, monthly quota) and daily aggregate counters (conversation count, product-click count) in Cloudflare D1. The widget sets no cookies and uses no localStorage; a session id lives only in memory for the current page view.

## Pricing

Free up to 100 conversations a month, no card. Starter: 19 EUR/month, up to 1,000 conversations. Pro: 39 EUR/month, up to 3,000 conversations. The shop upgrades from its own account page (https://arling.sk/asistent/tenant/?t=ACCOUNT_ID, linked right after signup), pays by card through Stripe, and can cancel any time.

## Pages

- Main page (Slovak and English, `?lang=en`), trial form: https://arling.sk/asistent/
- German page (Deutsch): https://arling.sk/asistent/de/
- WooCommerce plugin (English): https://arling.sk/asistent/woocommerce/
- Shopify (English): https://arling.sk/asistent/shopify/
- Shoptet and Upgates guide (Slovak; Heureka XML feed URL, script tag via the shop's HTML code editor): https://arling.sk/asistent/shoptet/
- Shoptet and Upgates guide (Czech): https://arling.sk/asistent/shoptet/cs/
- Slovak demo shop "Dobrá domácnosť" (fictional, 64 products in 6 categories, Heureka XML feed at https://arling.sk/asistent/ukazka/feed.xml, widget in Slovak with suggested questions and the Gift Finder button; nothing can be bought there): https://arling.sk/asistent/ukazka/
- Gift Finder (Slovak, "Hľadač darčekov"): a mode of the same widget, three questions (who for, budget, interests) instead of a chat, five picks from the shop's own feed with a one-sentence reason each, no new price, turned on with the data-gift="1" attribute: https://arling.sk/asistent/darceky/
- Gift Finder (English): https://arling.sk/asistent/gift-finder/
- Live demo: https://arling.sk/asistent/live/

## Comparisons (English)

Honest comparison pages. Competitor facts and prices were read from the competitors' public pricing pages on 5 September 2026 and are dated in the text; ARLing Asistent has no live chat with humans, no tickets and no multichannel inbox, and the pages say so.

- Tidio alternative for WooCommerce and Shopify stores: https://arling.sk/asistent/compare/tidio-alternative/
- Gorgias alternative for Shopify stores: https://arling.sk/asistent/compare/gorgias-alternative/
- Smartsupp alternative (Czech, Slovak, German shops): https://arling.sk/asistent/compare/smartsupp-alternative/
